blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Manufacturing & Industrial level this capability reads as: OPC UA/Sparkplug telemetry, MES and quality records unified with lineage (root cause in hours, not weeks). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

A fixed rhythm keeps progress visible from week one — here is the one we run. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline with your team: the current metric is measured, signed and stored as the reference for every later gate. Weeks 3–8 run the pilot on deliberately narrow scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, never quietly extended.
